skills.summary: Write a video script with hook and structure
skills.job: Turn a topic into a spoken script with hook, beats, visual cues and a call to action.
gotchas: Writing for the eye instead of the ear
Burying the hook after an intro
No visual cue for any beat

skills.summary: Storyboard a video as a shot-by-shot table
skills.job: Break a script into frames with framing, action, audio and duration.
gotchas: Frames with no purpose in the story
Cuts that break continuity of direction or props

skills.summary: Outline a podcast episode with segments
skills.job: Plan an episode with cold open, segments, transitions, timing and ending.
gotchas: Ending without a clear takeaway or next step

skills.summary: Write show notes from a transcript
skills.job: Create summary, timestamps, links and takeaways for an episode from its transcript.
gotchas: Timestamps that drift from the audio
Summaries that repeat the intro blurb

skills.summary: Clean a raw transcript without changing meaning
skills.job: Fix fillers, speaker labels, punctuation and errors in a raw transcript while keeping content faithful.
gotchas: Smoothing away what the speaker really said

skills.summary: Time and format subtitles for readability
skills.job: Split text into subtitle cues with sensible line length, duration and format such as SRT or VTT.
gotchas: Cues too long to read in time
Wrong decimal separator for the format

skills.summary: Build and check ffmpeg commands safely
skills.job: Compose ffmpeg commands for common conversions after checking the installed version and flags.
gotchas: Re-encoding when a stream copy would do

skills.summary: Plan an audio cleanup pass in order
skills.job: Diagnose recording problems and give an ordered cleanup chain with checks after each step.
gotchas: Heavy noise reduction that adds artifacts

skills.summary: Write a video description with chapters
skills.job: Write title options, description, chapters and tags for a video from its script or transcript.
gotchas: Clickbait the video does not deliver
Chapter times that do not match

skills.summary: Make a shot list for a shoot
skills.job: List shots with location, framing, gear, coverage and order for a shoot day.
gotchas: Shooting order that ignores location moves

skills.job: Write or adapt narration for voiceover with pacing marks, pronunciation notes and timing.
gotchas: Sentences too long for one breath
Narration that repeats what the picture shows

skills.summary: Pick short clips from a long recording
skills.job: Find self-contained moments in a transcript worth cutting into short clips with start and end points.
gotchas: Choosing by length rather than payoff

skills.summary: Plan an edit pass before cutting
skills.job: Turn footage notes and a goal into an ordered edit plan with cuts, pacing, audio and graphics.
triggers: how should I cut this video

skills.job: Build an ordered list of open questions with follow-ups and a safe opening for a recorded interview.
gotchas: Reading questions rigidly instead of listening

skills.summary: Brief music for a video or project
skills.job: Specify mood, tempo, structure, instruments and licence needs for a music cue.
gotchas: Temp track that no one can license

skills.job: Plan the clicks, narration and cuts for a clear software demo or tutorial recording.
